channel.title: Niger - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Niger, every source cited.

item.title: Diffa restaurant opens to promote local food and jobs
item.description: Hajia Oumma launched a new eatery on November 1, 2026, to showcase regional cuisine and create employment.

item.title: Niger receives 53 fuel tankers from Algeria
item.description: The shipment aims to alleviate global fuel supply tensions and bolster national capacity.

item.title: Algeria sends troops to Niger
item.description: Algeria's parliament approved the deployment of its army units to northern Niger on October 25.

item.title: Niger minister visits Tahoua region
item.description: Minister Abdourahamane Oumarou met with community leaders, artists, and academics during his five-day trip.

item.title: Niger forces neutralise seven mercenaries
item.description: Military operations in October 2026 recovered arms, communication devices, and destroyed enemy bases.
